about_the_game:
About the game:

Demo version of a romantic visual novel in the setting of a mental hospital. Shots of psycho-mistresses! But be careful... What if your girlfriend was replaced by the fantasy of an excited mind? Is this an illusion or reality?

A woman is not a simple thing. And a psycho-woman? You need to be careful if you value your life! Make the right choices in order to win the lady of your heart. 5 heroines. You can share love with each of them! Psycho love...

All characters are over 19 years old!!!

- 3+ hours of gameplay

- Comedic humor and tense tension

- 40+ cool soundtracks

- 27+ unique sprites

- 15+ unique backgrounds

No one has spoken to Sergei Ustinov all his life. He had no friends. No girlfriend. Why? Because he is schizophrenic. And the truth was always hidden from him. People around him had to lie. But now he knows everything. He hands himself over to the rich mental hospital "Phoenix". His new life will begin here. With schizophrenia at hand, he goes to look for friends and a girlfriend. But... Aren't crazy girls dangerous?

A silhouette in a white coat haunts at night. An unpleasant quiet voice. A frozen smile. What does he want? Who is he? Someone sends a watch. The address is missing. Sends suspicious letters. Something about Paradise... Another admirer? The psychiatrist is acting strange. Vague hints. Another package. A severed finger. Are you really you? This whole path... The path to this hospital? Was it really that?

How to start a new life if you can't even trust it?

Warning!

The game's scriptwriter is an idiot! His knowledge of psychology, the work of mental hospitals, and diseases is extremely superficial. They use these themes for the plot of the story, as well as associations that help the player understand the plot. The installation of a mental hospital allows you to fully reveal the problems of the work, and also easily convey the moral of the story to the player. If you are looking for authenticity, then you should not get acquainted with this game. Psycho Love: Paradise will often bring the action to the point of absurdity. For example, one of the diseases will have a fantastic basis, which has no place in the idea of ​​\u200b\u200blife. If the following warnings do not stop you, then we promise to captivate your game. Wonderful visuals, a wild plot, interesting dialogues, eccentric characters and mind-blowing music. You are experiencing heavenly pleasure!

content_descriptors.notes: Blood stains. Blood clots. A corpse with mutilations and cuts in the frame. A hint at rehabilitation from drug addiction.
